PagerDuty Bot: INCIDENT: hyperion-03 (gpu-node) kernel panic / kubelet NotReady — triggered 2329992222. Severity: P1. Resource: kube://cluster-prod/nodes/hyperion-03. Alert: node.unreachable, kubelet.status=NotReady, nvme.errors=multiple

Elena (oncall): acked — I'm on it. paging chain followed. updating channel.

Samir (oncall-2): ack — I'll standby for handoff if needed. Any running jobs on hyperion-03?

Elena (oncall): checking now. `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=hyperion-03` shows 6 pods, 4 are model-serving (redwood-model-prod/*) and 2 infra (prometheus-exporter, node-problem-detector). Will try to cordon/drain.

Alex (sre): :eyes: Post the node status and dmesg when you have it. If kernel panic, we might need serial console attach.

InfraBot: Auto-run: collected node metrics snapshot (5m): gpu_util=0%, heartbeats=lost, nvme_iostat spike, kernel_oops_count=1. Links: http://telemetry.local/nodes/hyperion-03/snap/2329992222

Elena (oncall): running `ssh hyperion-03 sudo journalctl -k -n 200 --no-pager | tail -n 80` — found repeated oops lines, stack trace referencing nvme driver then kernel panic: "Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception". Attaching snippet:

Elena (oncall): ```
[ 1234.567890] nvme 0000:3b:00.0: completed cmd 0x1c with status 0x400
[ 1234.568001] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000008
[ 1234.569123] CPU: 11 PID: 2345 Comm: kubelet Not tainted 5.10.0-rt #1
[ 1234.569456] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
```

Samir (oncall-2): yup that's kernel panic. What's current cluster reaction? Any evicted pods or reschedules?

Elena (oncall): The control-plane marked node NotReady and started rescheduling some pods. 2 model-serving pods restarted on other nodes but 2 are stuck Pending due to GPU limits. Customer impact: Ops (cust-impact) — can you estimate affected requests?

Ops (cust-impact): I'm pulling metrics. For last 5m, ~18% of requests to model-x were 503/retryable errors; 4 high-traffic customers saw increased latency >2s. No major SLO breaches yet but close. Putting notice on status page draft.

Marta (eng): Is there an automatic fallback to dedicated cluster? We had a canary fallback policy for model-x.

Nikhil (release): We have reserved capacity but the autoscaler didn't scale because the pod spec uses nodeSelector gpu=true only. Might need temporary override.

Elena (oncall): Plan: 1) cordon hyperion-03, 2) drain best-effort (delete pods with grace 30s where necessary), 3) attach serial console and attempt soft reboot, 4) if unresponsive, escalate for hardware swap. Initiating cordon/drain now.

Elena (oncall): `kubectl cordon hyperion-03` -> success. `kubectl drain hyperion-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30 --timeout=5m` -> started. 4 model pods: 2 rescheduled, 2 pending.

Alex (sre): If pods pending due to GPU quota, we can temporarily patch the deployment to tolerate missing GPUs by changing nodeSelector for fallback to `gpu=false` variant, but that changes performance. Recommend letting infra allocate dedicated fallback nodes first.

Elena (oncall): Attaching serial console to check hardware: `ipmi-console hyperion-03` -> console shows kernel oops loop. Attempting `reboot` via IPMI.

InfraBot: IPMI command issued by Elena (oncall) at 2329992310: cold-reboot. Waiting for host to return.

Samir (oncall-2): while rebooting, patch autoscaler: `kubectl apply -f deploy/autoscale-temp-patch.yaml` to allow GPU-optional scheduling?

Nikhil (release): I'll run the patch with you, Samir. Patch ready: add toleration for `gpu-optional=true` label and set `nodeAffinity` softPreferred. Rolling now.

Elena (oncall): Host is booting, kernel still shows panic on serial after reboot attempt -> appears to hit early boot panic. I'm opening ticket with hardware team to swap NVMe/box. Escalating to hw oncall.

Alex (sre): Good. Meanwhile we need mitigation for customers: 1) redirect traffic away from model-x endpoints with increased retry/backoff; 2) enable dedicated fallback pool for top customers; 3) notify customers via status page (Ops).

Ops (cust-impact): Status page update posted draft: "Investigating GPU host failure impacting inference for model-x. Some requests may see retries or increased latency. Engineers are actively mitigating." (Will publish after Elena confirms more.)

Marta (eng): For the two pending pods, if we can't free GPUs, can we start a reduced-precision quantized variant on cpu/gpu-less nodes as a temporary fallback? It will be slower but keeps availability.

Elena (oncall): Good idea. Samir/Nikhil can you coordinate: 1) patch deployments to a fallback revision (image: model-x:cpu-fallback-v2), 2) add feature flag so only customers with SLA get priority?

Samir (oncall-2): Starting patch now: `kubectl set image deployment/model-x-prod model-x=model-x:cpu-fallback-v2 --record`. Will limit replicas to 4 and add nodeAffinity to prefer cpu nodes.

Nikhil (release): Patch applied. Rolling update in progress. Two of the pending replicas are now starting on cpu nodes (warm start), but initial latencies 3-4x. Not ideal but reduces errors.

PagerDuty Bot: Escalation: hyperion-03 hardware team paged (hw-oncall). PagerDuty: escalation ack by "Ben (hw-oncall)" at 2329992378.

Ben (hw-oncall): acked. I'll queue a swap for hyperion-03 NVMe and run burn-in once swapped. ETA 90m (may be sooner).

Elena (oncall): Summary at 2329992400: node hyperion-03 kernel panic likely due to NVMe driver/hw. Immediate mitigations: cordon/drain (done), cold-reboot attempted (still kernel panic), fallback rollout to cpu variant for model-x (in progress), reserve dedicated fallback nodes for top customers. Customer impact: ~18% increased retries; top 4 customers affected. Next steps: hw swap ETA 90m, follow-up re-eval at +60m.

Alex (sre): I'll create an incident ticket with root cause hypothesis and link diagnostics (dmesg, telemetry, pod events). Adding runbook links: runbooks/internal/node-failure.md, runbooks/internal/gpu-fallback.md

Elena (oncall): tagging @Samir and @Ben for handoff — I'm on duty for another 20m then Samir will take over if still ongoing. Leaving channel for now but will monitor via PagerDuty.

Samir (oncall-2): taking over. I'll coordinate hw swap and keep status updates every 30m.

Ops (cust-impact): Published status update. Notified support to triage inbound tickets with priority flag.

Marta (eng): Postmortem notes request: preserve all logs (serial console dump, journalctl -k, kubectl describe node/pod). I'll start capturing the artifacts.

Nikhil (release): tagging followups: 1) validate autoscaler tolerations and fallback automaticization, 2) add early-warning nvme iostat anomaly detection, 3) test cold-reboot & serial recovery playbook.

PagerDuty Bot: Incident P1 hyperion-03 assigned to Samir (oncall-2) at 2329992428.

Samir (oncall-2): acknowledged handoff. continuing monitoring. will update next at 2330000000 or earlier if status changes.

Elena (oncall): :thumbsup: thanks team.

(End of thread)
